description: Data for distribution grid resilience research is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Zhecheng Wang. This repo contains data needed for the code repository: https://github.com/wangzhecheng/vulnerability. This data is for supporting the research on distribution grid resilience to wildfires, led by Stanford Sustainable Systems Lab, with the aim to make electricity infrastructure more affordable, equitable, and resilient to climate-induced extreme events. Abstract: Climate-induced extreme weather conditions make electricity infrastructure more vulnerable. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 423241672 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
